events.title: Devlog #1: From a Real-Life Inspiring Journey to "Farm of Hope"
events.summary: Hello everyone, and welcome to our very first Developer Blog!We are absolutely thrilled to announce that our Steam Store page is officially live. Today, for our first entry, we don't want to talk about raw code or complex mechanics.
